# Zelvori Software

> Zelvori Software turns ideas into digital products, including websites, web applications, mobile apps, e-commerce, business software, AI integration and custom software.

Official website: https://zelvori.software/

## Services
- [Website and web app development](https://zelvori.software/services/website-development.html): Business websites, landing pages, portals, browser-based apps and responsive front-end work.
- [Mobile app development](https://zelvori.software/services/mobile-app-development.html): Android and iOS product planning, mobile experiences, integrations and release preparation.
- [E-commerce development](https://zelvori.software/services/ecommerce-development.html): Storefronts, catalogs, checkout planning and commerce workflows.
- [Business software](https://zelvori.software/services/business-software.html): CRM, HRMS, ERP, workflow portals and reporting dashboards.
- [AI and automation](https://zelvori.software/services/ai-automation.html): Practical AI integration, document workflows and task automation with human review where appropriate.
- [Custom software](https://zelvori.software/services/custom-software.html): Purpose-built internal tools, integrations and digital platforms.

## Contact
